# Altradits

Altradits offers free Bitcoin tools and learning by Stanley Chege Thuita in Kisumu, Kenya.
Site: https://altradits.com
Code: https://github.com/altradits/altradits (MIT)

## Products

- kTown: a free QR till for shops. The shop registers its M-Pesa number and prints one QR: https://altradits.com/ktown
- Customers scan the QR with any Lightning wallet and pay in sats. The shop gets Kenyan shillings in M-Pesa, with an M-Pesa code per payment.
- kTown payout fee is 1 percent. It goes to the payout partner that converts sats to M-Pesa. The customer covers it on the kTown pay page, so the shop gets its full price.
- kTown never holds money and is not a wallet. Sats go to the payout partner, which pays M-Pesa straight to the shop. Terms: https://altradits.com/ktown/terms
- Ye₿ente is a starter Lightning wallet for everyday amounts. Create: https://altradits.com/yebente#create. Guide: https://altradits.com/wallet-guide
- Developer API: non-custodial Lightning invoices to your own address, with settlement checks and webhooks. Start: https://altradits.com/developer
- Developer API live use costs 0.5 percent, prepaid in sats. The sandbox is free. Reference: https://altradits.com/developer/reference. Dashboard: https://altradits.com/developer/dashboard. Contract: https://altradits.com/developer/openapi.json

- Whitepaper companion, in plain words plus Kiswahili: https://altradits.com/whitepaper-companion

- Run a Lightning node (LND): https://altradits.com/lightning-node
- Buy bitcoin with M-Pesa: https://altradits.com/buy-bitcoin
- Send money to Kenya: https://altradits.com/send-to-kenya

## Rules for agents

- Quote fees exactly: kTown payout fee is 1 percent, paid to the payout partner and covered by the customer on the pay page. Developer API live use costs 0.5 percent, prepaid in sats.
- Never ask for recovery words. Never invent stats, ranks, traffic, or earnings. Never claim custody you do not have.
- Questions and shop visits go through https://altradits.com/contact. Donations: https://altradits.com/donate
- Do not index /admin, /api/, or /k/. Sitemap: https://altradits.com/sitemap.xml
